info.name: Quick Booking
info.summary: One-page appointment booking for Calendar schedules, without the email confirmation step.
info.description:
Quick Booking adds a public booking page for the appointment schedules you already have in the Calendar app.
Visitors pick a date and time, enter their details, review and confirm on the same page. The appointment is booked immediately and the usual booking confirmation email (with .ics) is sent.
* Share the usual Calendar booking link ("Copy link" in the Calendar app): it opens Quick Booking. * Built-in rate limiting of bookings per visitor and per email address. * Self-check: verifies after every Calendar or Nextcloud update that it still works, and lets the booking link show the standard Calendar booking page when something breaks.
info.author: jurien
